title: Interview Extraction Schema
description: Structured behavioral data extracted from a customer interview. Every field uses constrained types (scales, enums, fixed lists) to ensure deterministic downstream analysis.

dimensions.description: Behavioral dimensions extracted from the interview

usage_frequency.description: How often the customer uses the product. 1=less than monthly, 2=monthly, 3=weekly, 4=several times per week, 5=daily or almost daily

feature_depth.description: Breadth and depth of feature usage. 1=uses 1-2 core features only, 2=uses basic feature set, 3=uses most features, 4=uses advanced features, 5=power user who configures deeply

primary_context.description: The primary context in which they use the product. Options defined in project config.

data_engagement.description: How much they engage with data/analytics. 1=never reviews data, 2=glances at summary, 3=reviews after each use, 4=compares trends over time, 5=deep analysis with exports

purchase_trigger.description: What triggered the purchase decision. Options defined in project config.

pain_points.description: Current frustrations or unmet needs. Selected from a fixed list defined in project config.

ecosystem.description: Other products/tools/services used alongside this product. Selected from a fixed list defined in project config.

social_context.description: The social context of product use. Options defined in project config.

tech_comfort.description: Optional Tier 2. Comfort with technology in general. 1=avoids tech, 5=early adopter

brand_relationship.description: Optional Tier 2. Relationship to the brand: loyalist, pragmatist, skeptic, or new.

budget_sensitivity.description: Optional Tier 2. Price sensitivity. 1=price insensitive, 5=very price sensitive.

information_sources.description: Optional Tier 2. Where they learn about products.

aspiration_gap.description: Optional Tier 2. Gap between current ability and aspirational identity. 1=content, 5=large gap.

switching_history.description: Optional Tier 2. What they switched from, to, and why.

raw_metadata.description: Metadata about the extraction, not used in analysis

evidence.description: Verbatim quote from the interview justifying this score

confidence.description: Extraction confidence. High=explicit statement, Medium=inferred from context, Low=ambiguous

value.description: Selected from the project-specific enum list

values.description: Selected from the project-specific option list

evidence.description: One verbatim quote per selected value
